postkarten.leer: No postcard yet. Gooby has to travel first.

souvenir.leer: The shelf is still empty — every trip brings a souvenir.

set.hinweis: Visit many destinations and collect extra coins.

wand.beschreibung: Shows the newest postcards from the archive on your wall.
wand.erhalten: New in storage: the postcard wall! Hang it in build mode.

beach.1: The sand really sparkles here. Gooby adopted three shells.
beach.2: Waves counted: all of them. Gooby waves at every single fish.
beach.3: Sun hat on, paws in the sand — that is the whole plan today.
beach.4: The sea sounds like applause. Gooby takes a bow, just in case.
beach.5: Sandcastle number four stands! The tide politely waits.

meadowTrip.1: So many flowers! Gooby sneezes with joy.
meadowTrip.2: A butterfly sat on Gooby's nose. Both acted very calm.
meadowTrip.3: Picnic in the tall grass — carrots taste twice as good here.
meadowTrip.4: Gooby wove a flower crown. It sits a bit crooked. Perfect.
meadowTrip.5: The meadow hums and buzzes. Gooby simply hums along.

bigCity.1: Such tall buildings! Gooby stretches his neck like never before.
bigCity.2: The subway wobbles funnily. Gooby wobbles along in solidarity.
bigCity.3: Lights, lights, lights — the city sparkles into his dreams.
bigCity.4: Gooby ate a pretzel bigger than his head.
bigCity.5: On the viewing deck: wind in the ears, grin on the face.

space.1: Weightless! Gooby's ears just float along.
space.2: Earth looks like a marble from here. A pretty one.
space.3: Stars close enough to touch — Gooby hurt none of them.
space.4: Space carrots float away. Gooby chases them in slow motion.
space.5: In the space suit Gooby looks like a very round hero.

harbor.1: The seagulls know Gooby by name now. They all want fries.
harbor.2: Big ships, small bunny — both honk in a friendly way.
harbor.3: The lighthouse blinks good night. Gooby blinks back.
harbor.4: Tried a fish sandwich. Manners briefly beat hunger.
harbor.5: Practiced sailor knots: the result is modern art.

spookGarden.1: Boo! The ghosts here are polite and very fluffy.
spookGarden.2: A pumpkin smiled at Gooby. Gooby smiled wider.
spookGarden.3: Night fog in the garden — perfect for hide and seek with ghosts.
spookGarden.4: The cobwebs glitter like garlands. Spookily cozy.
spookGarden.5: Gooby practiced saying 'boo'. The ghosts found it adorable.

bakery.1: It smells like warm bread. Gooby mentally lives here now.
bakery.2: The baker let Gooby knead the dough. The dough won.
bakery.3: Cinnamon rolls as big as wheels. Gooby rolls with joy.
bakery.4: Flour on the nose, pride in the eyes: Gooby's first bun!
bakery.5: The croissant crunches louder than Gooby. Barely.

nightSky.1: Counted shooting stars and wished for the same thing: carrots.
nightSky.2: The moon is extra round today. Gooby feels understood.
nightSky.3: The Milky Way glitters like spilled sugar. Pretty!
nightSky.4: Gooby discovered a constellation: the Great Bunny.
nightSky.5: At night the sky is a sparkle park with free entry.

toyRoom.1: Everything is huge! Or Gooby is tiny. Both are funny.
toyRoom.2: The building blocks make a tower up to the lampshade.
toyRoom.3: A toy train carries Gooby across the room. First class.
toyRoom.4: Hide and seek between plushies: Gooby always wins.
toyRoom.5: The marble run clatters a lullaby. Gooby dozes off.
